unit.title: Olympiad Round
unit.about: 12 hard problems, each answer a whole number. Show your working on paper – then compare it with the full solution.
unit.note: Written by the Atomic teaching team in the style of national maths challenges. Not UKMT papers.

01.prompt: The number 35! means 35 × 34 × … × 2 × 1. How many zeros are at the end of 35! ?
The number 422 is written in base 8. What is it in base 10?
The diagram shows three angles around a point. What is the value of x?
What is the remainder when 2⁵⁷⁶ is divided by 11?
A triangle has vertices at (−4, 4), (1, −4) and (−1, 6). What is its area?
An ant walks along the lines of a grid from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner of a 4 × 3 grid of squares, moving only right or up. How many different routes are there?
What is the sum of the digits of 10⁹ − 13?
A rectangle is divided into a 3 × 4 grid of unit squares. How many rectangles (of any size, including squares) can be seen?
A club has 8 boys and 5 girls. A team of 3 boys and 1 girl is chosen. How many different teams are possible?
How many three-digit numbers have digits that add up to 9?
What is the smallest whole number greater than 10 that leaves remainder 1 when divided by 5, remainder 6 when divided by 11 and remainder 6 when divided by 9?

02.prompt: 4 apples weigh the same as 3 pears. A pear weighs 55 g more than an apple. How much does one pear weigh?
How many pairs of positive whole numbers (x, y) satisfy 4x + 7y = 58?
The diagram shows three angles around a point. What is the value of x?
A snail is at the bottom of a well 21 m deep. Each day it climbs up 4 m, but each night it slides back 1 m. On which day does it first reach the top?
How many different arrangements are there of the letters of the word LEVEL?
How many squares of any size can be found on a 5 × 5 chessboard-style grid of unit squares?
For how many whole numbers n from 10 to 100 does n² end in the digit 6?
Five different positive whole numbers have mean 8 and median 7. What is the largest possible value of the biggest number?
If x + 1/x = 4, what is the value of x² + 1/x² ?
The digits of every whole number from 1 to 99 are added together. What is the total?
Two whole numbers have highest common factor 3 and lowest common multiple 297. Neither number is equal to 3. What is their sum?
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards, like 474. How many three-digit palindromes are multiples of 3?

03.prompt: A cuboid has faces with areas 64 cm², 72 cm² and 72 cm². What is its volume?
Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 140°. How many sides does the polygon have?
The diagram shows three angles around a point. What is the value of x?
In a triangle, one angle is 36°. Another angle is 2 times the third angle. What is the size of the largest angle?
The product of three consecutive whole numbers is 6840. What is their sum?
A rectangle is divided into a 2 × 4 grid of unit squares. How many rectangles (of any size, including squares) can be seen?
A club has 5 boys and 4 girls. A team of 2 boys and 2 girls is chosen. How many different teams are possible?
A triangle has vertices at (1, 4), (−2, −4) and (−2, 6). What is its area?
What is the remainder when 2¹²⁹⁹ is divided by 11?
An ant walks along the lines of a grid from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner of a 4 × 5 grid of squares, moving only right or up. How many different routes are there?
For how many whole numbers n from 10 to 200 does n² end in the digit 6?
What is the smallest whole number greater than 10 that leaves remainder 4 when divided by 5, remainder 6 when divided by 8 and remainder 2 when divided by 3?

04.prompt: Two numbers have sum 33 and difference 1. What is their product?
How many of the whole numbers from 1 to 300 are multiples of 4 or 6 (or both)?
A three-digit number has digits a, b, c (in that order), where a − c = 1. The digits are reversed and the new number is subtracted from the original. What is the result?
The clock shows 12:40. What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand?
If x + 1/x = 3, what is the value of x² + 1/x² ?
How many squares of any size can be found on an 8 × 8 chessboard-style grid of unit squares?
A cuboid has faces with areas 18 cm², 4 cm² and 18 cm². What is its volume?
What is the sum of the digits of 10¹⁷ − 7?
The number 2212 is written in base 3. What is it in base 10?
How many pairs of positive whole numbers (x, y) satisfy 4x + 7y = 53?
How many three-digit numbers have digits that add up to 5?
The number 61! means 61 × 60 × … × 2 × 1. How many zeros are at the end of 61! ?
